summary.text:
Draws all texts into a canvas, Y-flipped for WebGL upload (same output
as the legacy dataURL round-trip, but synchronous via a second canvas).

The built, renderable form of a Material for one Mapping: the composed
THREE.ShaderMaterial plus live uniform interfaces.
fans a value out to every text;

writes a
single text's slot in the user uniforms data texture.

Per-text output: a canvas that copies this text's rectangle out of the
Blotter atlas each frame, plus per-text uniform overrides.
Pixel ratio for all output canvases. Default: the device pixel ratio.
Build the mapping immediately on construction. Default true.
Start the render loop automatically. Default true.
New RenderScopes start in the playing state. Default true.

Orchestrator: packs all texts into one atlas, renders them through the
material's shader in a single draw call, and hands each text its own
output canvas via forText().
Resolves after the first successful build.

Rebuild the atlas and shader from the current texts and material.
Concurrent calls coalesce: one build runs at a time, with at most one
trailing rebuild queued. Emits "ready" on the first completion,
"update" on later ones.

Live handle for one uniform: validated value writes emit "update" so
owners (Material, MappingMaterial, RenderScope) can propagate changes.
Consolidates the three duplicated ad-hoc interface objects from the
legacy codebase.
